brief:
Talks to form an Israeli unity government have stalled between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot over disagreements on a rotation arrangement and coalition demands, Al Jazeera English reported. Eisenkot has struggled to build consensus among potential coalition partners on the terms of their power-sharing agreement.

The deadlock centers on how long each leader would serve as prime minister under a proposed rotation deal and what political concessions each side requires to join the government.
dek: Eisenkot struggles to form a government as talks with Netanyahu stall over rotation deal and coalition compromises.
title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot stall on government rotation deal
